Growth Hacker
Can I use Lovart images for commercial Google Ads campaigns?
Yes! All assets generated on paid Lovart plans come with a full commercial license, making them safe to use for all your paid advertising campaigns.
What aspect ratios does Lovart support for banners?
You can generate in standard ratios like 1:1, 16:9, or 9:16 directly. For specific ad sizes like 728x90 or 160x600, you can use the 'Expand' and 'Crop' tools to adapt any image perfectly.
How do I add my own product to the banner?
Upload your product photo, use 'Remove BG' to isolate it, and then place it onto any AI-generated background. You can also use Nano Banana Pro to keep product consistency.
Can I edit the text on the generated banners?
Absolutely. Lovart's 'Text Edit' feature is designed for this. You can change headlines, CTAs, and prices directly on the image while maintaining the original design style.
Does it support text in languages other than English?
Yes, Lovart supports text generation and editing in multiple languages, allowing you to create localized ad campaigns for global markets.
